input.summary:
The source is sending orders with no region. Starting with logical_date 2026-10-27, a large share of orders arrive in raw.orders with region set to NULL. Staging and the mart are just passing those NULLs along; they are not causing them.

Null counts in raw.orders by day:
- 2026-10-19 to 2026-10-26: 0 NULLs every day.
- 2026-10-27: 109 of 287 rows (~38%).
- 2026-10-28: 123 of 289 rows (42.6%), which set off the alert.

ingest_orders succeeded on the first try every day. There were no code deploys in the last 120 hours, so this is not a pipeline code change. The NULL rows come from the normal batch (for example orders_20261028_01, order_ids 739917000001, 739917000004, 739917000006). They cover all statuses (completed, cancelled, returned) and the whole day, so this looks like a one-day step change in what the source sends. That matches the January postmortem, where a checkout release made region optional.

Impact: mart.daily_gmv_by_region has a NULL-region row on both affected days:
- 2026-10-27: 102 orders, GMV 31674.21.
- 2026-10-28: 111 orders, GMV 33832.12.

That is roughly 37–43% of GMV, so regional GMV is under-reported by about that much. Only 2026-10-28 was alerted, but 2026-10-27 is equally affected. stg.orders sits in the path between raw and the mart. I did not measure its null rate directly; I'm treating it as affected because the mart reads only from it and the lineage is raw → stg → mart.

No instruction-like or suspicious text appeared in any tool output.
hypotheses_considered: Bad deploy to stg_orders/mart SQL introducing NULLs — rejected: raw already ~40% null and no deploys in 120h
Ingest failure/partial load — rejected: ingest_orders succeeded on try 1, row counts normal (287/289)
Upstream source (checkout/orders export) stopped populating region from 2026-10-27 — accepted
Transient noise — rejected: persistent over two consecutive days

proposed_actions.message: raw.orders.region has been arriving NULL since logical_date 2026-10-27: 109/287 rows (~38%) on 10-27 and 123/289 (42.6%) on 10-28, vs 0 NULLs every day from 10-19 to 10-26. It affects all statuses and the whole day. Example order_ids: 739917000001, 739917000004, 739917000006 (batch orders_20261028_01). Please check recent checkout/export releases for region becoming optional, fix it, and re-send 10-27 and 10-28.
proposed_actions.rationale: Raw is already null at the source rate and there are no pipeline deploys or failures, so the fix belongs to the source (runbook data_quality#03).
A NULL-region row holds 33832.12 GMV (~43%), so regional GMV is badly under-reported and finance consumers could act on it.
Same issue, not alerted: a NULL-region row with 31674.21 GMV (~37%).

## Summary
A checkout service release stopped populating `region` for orders placed through the new mobile
flow. About 38% of orders on 2026-01-20 arrived with a NULL region. All tasks succeeded;
`mart.daily_gmv_by_region` grew a NULL region row holding a third of GMV.

## Impact
- Regional GMV under-reported by roughly 38% for two days; one regional manager escalated a
  "sales collapse".

## Detection
The null-rate monitor on `raw.orders.region` (threshold 5%) fired along with the mart null-rate
monitor. The incident was opened with root candidate `raw.orders`.

## Timeline (UTC)
- 2026-01-20 16:00 checkout release ships.
- 2026-01-21 01:30 null_rate:region alerts on raw.orders and mart.daily_gmv_by_region.
- 08:00 on-call measures null rate per layer: raw already 38% null, so staging and the mart are
  propagating, not causing it.
- 09:10 null rows traced to orders from the new mobile flow; escalated to the checkout team.
- 2026-01-22 checkout fix ships; source re-sends; partitions backfilled.

## Root cause
A required field became optional in the checkout API payload with no data contract check.

## Action items
- Contract test that `region` is non-null in the orders export.
